<thought>To obtain the required precursors I need the retrosynthetic template for the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction. I will search the template catalog using functional groups that are broken (a carboxylic ester, representing the phosphonate ester) and the functional group that is formed (a C‑C double bond, i.e., an alkene). Once I have the template ID, I will apply it to each of the three target SMILES provided earlier to generate all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
